title: A deep learning model for drug screening and evaluation in bladder cancer organoids.
summary: The model improved organoid-image segmentation over classical algorithms and was used to compare drug-treated organoid growth over time.
ai_technology: ACU2Net/U2Net-family segmentation measured bladder-cancer organoid growth after retinoic-acid and B0107 exposure.
organization: School of Information Science and Engineering

evidence.tested: The model improved organoid-image segmentation over classical algorithms and was used to compare drug-treated organoid growth over time.
evidence.unknown: A 200-image dataset with expert pixel labels and train/validation/test partitions; organoid lines and assay conditions limit biological generalization.
